method: offline Unicorn runs over the memory image. Query: synthetic 8-bit quantized trees (balanced, chains, skewed and random splits up to several thousand nodes, random flags and quantized bytes, leaf ids anywhere in 0..0xffff) with root/query-box variants (full, sub-box, point, inverted, zero or negative extents, special lanes); return value, the whole 0x40000-byte id buffer (guard included) and the allocator-event sequence of the queue growth compared with engine.pose_terrain6_tree_query. Filter: synthetic kind-6 shapes/meshes (grids, steps, planes, soups; edge tables from the harness adjacency, some edges cut to 0xffff, sometimes no pair table), identity or random frames with lane-3 junk, 0..12 records placed at vertices, edges, interiors and outside with varied directions; return value and every record byte (plus two guard records) compared with engine.pose_terrain6_edge_filter. Composed: the capsule x kind-6 harness cases (half forced to mode 2) run through 0x198af50 natively and through engine.pose_narrowphase_capsule_terrain6 with query/edge_filter bound to the two new models (nothing supplied from the native run); return value and all 520 output records plus a guard compared. Inputs must be unchanged; executed blocks must stay in the named routines, the stack probe, memcpy and the allocator stubs.
fixtures: global allocator object at 0x1433365b8 with alloc/realloc/free stubs (bump allocation; realloc copies)
0x18c9140 / 0x18c8f50 replaced by ret stubs (reach obfuscated thunks; not traced)
runtime statics 0x3336890 (XYZ mask), 0x3336cb0, 0x3336cc0, 0x3336cd0 from their initializer sources
gs/TLS stack-probe fixtures as in the tester harness

bug_injections.bug: capacity checked before the write (capacity 0 returns nothing)
edge neighbour read from slot j instead of (j + 1) % 3
vertex fan stops after the first neighbour

limits: Synthetic trees, meshes and adjacency, not game assets; the real kind-6 edge-table convention (which slot holds which edge) is unknown, and the edge test reads slot (j+1)%3.
MXCSR is the Unicorn default 0x1f80; hardware two-NaN choice not observed.
Allocation is a fixture; only the event sequence (kind and size) is compared.
Non-terminating fan walks (possible with inconsistent adjacency) are not exercised natively.
